name: dev.themes/ui
title: themes.dev UI
description: Search and install shadcn/ui blocks, components and page templates. Free items need no key.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Lists catalogue items by their store number (hero-12, app-crm-01, template-home), optionally filtered. access: open (free, no key) or pro (UI Pro). kind: ui (primitive), block (page section), app (app screen), template (whole page). category: e.g. "hero", "pricing", "footer", "app-crm", "templates".

access.description: Who may install: "open" for free items that need no key, "pro" for UI Pro items that need the user's API key. "account" is kept for older clients and matches nothing now. Leave out for both.

kind.description: What sort of item: "ui" a primitive (button, input), "block" a page section (hero, pricing), "app" an app screen, "template" a whole page. Leave out for all kinds.

category.description: Store category slug, as in the item URLs: "hero", "pricing", "footer", "app-crm", "templates". Leave out for every category.

limit.description: How many items to return, 1 to 200. Default 50.

offset.description: How many matching items to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Finds items by words in their name, title and description, best match first. Example: "pricing table", "sign in form".

query.description: Words to look for, in English, e.g. "pricing table" or "sign in form". Every word must match.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 50. Default 15.

tools.name: show_item
tools.description: One item: what it is, who may install it, and, when the caller may, its registry entry with the files and their code.

name.description: The item's store number, as list_items and search_items return it, e.g. "hero-12" or "template-home".

tools.name: install_item
tools.description: Checks that the caller may install the items and returns the shadcn command to run in the project, plus the components.json entry for the @themesdev namespace. Run the command yourself; this tool changes nothing.

names.description: Store numbers of the items to install, 1 to 20, e.g. ["hero-12", "pricing-03"].
